title: Rurouni Kenshin
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1878 Japan, former assassin Himura Kenshin wanders with a reverse-bladed sword, having vowed never to kill again. Living at Kaoru's dojo with Sanosuke, Yahiko and Megumi, he faces swordsmen testing his vow, the revolutionary Shishio in Kyoto, and finally Enishi, brother of the wife Kenshin accidentally killed. Viz publishes it in English; reviewers in Library Journal and VOYA recommended it for older teens.
life_message: It holds up atonement through protecting others and refusing to kill, and rejects revenge.
